meta.name: li-human
meta.description: Strip the machine fingerprint out of any draft - em dashes, AI slop words, invisible watermark characters - and score it against a five-check detection panel before it goes out. Use whenever text needs to sound human, when the user says humanize, "does this sound like AI", "remove the em dashes", "de-slop this", "will this get flagged", or before any LinkedIn post, comment, reply or DM is shown to the user.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把带 AI 味的草稿改成读起来像人写的,并在发布前先自检会不会被识破
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常写社媒文案,又担心行文一看就是机器生成的。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you post on social often and worry your drafts read as machine-written.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会改掉草稿里的破折号、AI 套话词和隐形水印字符,再按五项检查打分,最后把清理后的文本和分数一起给你。
howto.when: 当你说“humanize”“这像 AI 写的吗”“去掉破折号”等,或者要在 LinkedIn 发帖、评论、回信之前,它就会接管。

say.text: 帮我把这段草稿去 AI 味,并告诉我改了哪些地方
say.note: 会运行清理脚本并输出改动报告。

say.text: 这段文字像 AI 写的吗?给我五项检测的分数
say.note: 输出五项得分和 PASS 或 REVIEW 判定。

say.text: 改完再跑一次检测,对比一下前后的分数
say.note: 给出修改前后的分数差。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude strips em dashes, AI slop words and invisible watermark characters from a draft, scores it against five checks, and shows you the cleaned text plus the score.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "humanize", "does this sound like AI" or "remove the em dashes", or before any LinkedIn post, comment or reply is shown.

say_en.text: De-slop this draft for me and tell me what changed
say_en.note: Runs the cleaner and prints a change report.

say_en.text: Does this read like AI? Give me the five-check score
say_en.note: Returns the five scores and the verdict.

say_en.text: Re-run the detector and compare before and after
